captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a double-ended snap-fit pin connector designed for joining parts. It features two identical cylindrical shafts mirrored back-to-back, each ending in a sharp conical taper to facilitate insertion. A long slot runs through the center of the body to allow the two halves of each shaft to compress inward during insertion. Each side of the connector is equipped with raised snap nubs near the center to lock the pin into its corresponding hole.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric snap-fit pin connector library in OpenSCAD with options to generate a double-ended pin peg (pinpeg) and a matching pin hole (pinhole). The pin peg should feature mirrored halves, a central slot for compression, tapered conical ends, and small snap nubs, with adjustable parameters for diameter, length, clearance, and wall thickness.
captions.factory: The code defines a parametric system with modules for a single 'pin', a 'nub', a 'pinhole', and a double-ended 'pinpeg'. The 'pin' module is constructed by rotating and intersecting a union of cylinders (for the shaft and tapered tip) and custom 'nub' shapes with a limiting bounding cube, then subtraction-cutting a central slot using a cube and two cylinders. The 'pinpeg' module mirrors two of these 'pin' instances back-to-back using the mirror transform. The 'nub' module uses stacked cylinders with tapered diameters (r1 and r2) to create a smooth, ramped latching profile.
